banner.title: Sign-in passes on both apps
banner.body: The sign-in test passed on Android and iOS in run 40055826521. The other flows show the 23 Oct run; every flow runs again next.

means.1: A new account goes from hello to done, through email, phone, computer, apps, look and notifications, and lands in chats.
means.2: Sign in, see your chats; sign out, back to sign-in.
means.3: Connections are listed. You connect Gmail or Calendar, and May can read it.
means.4: Send a message and get a reply. Stop and retry work.
means.5: May asks a multiple-choice question. You answer it, or skip it with a free reply.
means.6: The agenda loads. Add a task or event, add a note, complete it, move it.
means.7: May asks before acting. You approve or decline, and the result shows in chat and For you.
means.8: Suggestions and updates show. Accept, dismiss, mark done and snooze work.
means.9: Ask May in chat for a routine. It appears and runs on schedule.
means.10: May has an inbox. Mail to it shows up, and May drafts a reply for approval.
means.11: Ask May to do something on a website. You can watch the computer page, and it finishes or asks you.
means.12: Speak to May and hear her answer. The session ends cleanly.
means.13: The permission ask appears at the agreed moment, and a push arrives and opens the right place.
means.14: Create, rename and restyle an agent. Change the model. Delete the account.
means.15: Take notes on an event by voice or typing. The transcript is kept, a summary lands in Notes, and an action item can be added as a task.
